name: OLESKO
install: echo 'OLESKO is the source-of-truth repository for oleskostudio.com (Webflow content, rules, and HTML/JS embeds). There are no dependencies to install and no build step.'

terminals.name: preview
terminals.description: Static preview server for the repo root. Open http://localhost:8000/.cursor-share-embed.html to preview HTML/JS embeds in a browser before pasting them into Webflow. The Webflow site itself is edited remotely via the Webflow MCP.
